Thank you for the support and feedback![/p][list][*][p]All item prices have been balanced.,[/p][/*][*][p]Profit margins have been adjusted.,[/p][/*][*][p]The maximum number of customers has been increased.,[/p][/*][*][p]New customer models have been added.,[/p][/*][*][p]Plenty of bug fixes[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Comic Book Store Simulator Demo Available Now!
notes.content: [p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3870160/Comic_Book_Store_Simulator_Demo/?beta=0"][/dynamiclink][/p][h1]Play The FREE DEMO Now![/h1][p]Great news! Comic Book Store Simulator now has a [b]FREE demo available on Steam![/b][/p][p]Come try it out and experience life as a comic book store owner! In this demo, you'll play the opening sections of Comic Book Store Simulator. [/p][p][/p][p]There's no time limit on how long you can play the demo, but features and progression are limited compared to the full game. Don't forget to wishlist the game if you enjoyed the demo! ❤️[/p][p][/p][p]Check out our trailer to see what we've made![/p][previewyoutube="lh3B9R50ikg;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]Please note,[/b] [b]your progress and save data from the demo cannot be transferred to the full version of the game.[/b][/p]
